item.title: Perspective: Shame on GW Law for welcoming ICE against its stated values
item.description: Last week, over 1,200 students, alumni and organizations from GW Law and Georgetown University Law Center signed a petition urging the universities to block U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement from participating in their annual public interest career fair. ICE voluntarily withdrew ahead of Friday’s fair due to mounting pressure from students, but the law school...

item.title: Women’s basketball edges Saint Louis 64-62 with late-game surge
item.description: Women’s basketball (12-11, 4-6 Atlantic 10) used a strong fourth quarter to top Saint Louis (11-12, 5-5 A-10), 64-62 on Wednesday night.

item.title: From Snowzilla to Snowmageddon, snowstorms have long stalled GW and DC
item.description: A look through The Hatchet’s archives makes one thing clear as ice: Neither the District nor GW has yet learned how to handle a major snowstorm.

item.title: Scholar discusses US foreign policy failures, debate over American power
item.description: Washington Post columnist Shadi Hamid said despite U.S. foreign policy failures, American power remains preferable to authoritarian alternatives during a virtual event hosted by the Elliott School of International Affairs Tuesday.

item.title: Students launch chapter of public interest pre-law organization
item.description: Students launched a Public Interest Law Association chapter within the Pre-Law Student Association this month, aiming to introduce peers to careers centered on social justice, civil liberties and advocacy for marginalized communities.

item.title: Former Ward 2 councilmember to run for at-large council seat
item.description: Former Ward 2 D.C. Councilmember Jack Evans said he would challenge Council Chair Phil Mendelson in the June Democratic primary to become chair of the council.

item.title: Snowstorm forces fifth straight day of campus closures, online classes
item.description: In the wake of Sunday's snowstorm, which has left much of the District still stuck under inches of frozen snow, officials closed campus again Thursday.

item.title: SBA commends students for pressuring GW Law to bar ICE from career fair
item.description: The Student Bar Association Senate commended students for urging GW Law officials to disinvite U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement from the school’s public interest career fair.

item.title: GW to revive RA program with hybrid model
item.description: GW last employed RAs in 2021 before they discontinued the program, transitioning to a model of non-residential student staff and residential professional community coordinators.

item.title: Men’s basketball drops second straight in 79-65 loss to Fordham
item.description: Men's basketball's struggles continued with a 79-65 loss to the Fordham Rams on Saturday.
